title: Space-X: Self-Evolving Spatial Agents Weaving Clues into Evidence Chains
abstract: arXiv:2611.24004v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial reasoning connects visual observations, geometric estimates, and linguistic decisions into a coherent derivation. Yet tool-augmented agents often acquire evidence without clear targets, combine outputs under inconsistent object or reference-frame semantics, and misjudge evidence sufficiency. Thus, more tools or calls do not reliably improve reasoning. We introduce Space-X, a spatial-reasoning framework that self-evolves toward complete, continuous evidence-chain construction. An Execution Agent acquires, associates, and judges evidence per problem using role-specific memory. A Control Agent diagnoses evidence-chain breaks from execution traces and jointly revises tools, interfaces, skills, memory organization, and decision rules. This loop co-evolves capability and evidence use: evidence needs guide capability development; usable results guide actions. Across multiple benchmarks, Space-X yields gains with four base models. translated_title: Space-X：将线索编织成证据链的自进化空间智能体
translated_abstract: 空间推理将视觉观察、几何估计和语言决策连接成连贯的推导过程。然而，工具增强的智能体常常在没有明确目标的情况下获取证据，在不一致的对象或参考系语义下组合输出，并错误判断证据的充分性。因此，更多的工具或调用并不能可靠地改进推理。我们提出了Space-X，一个朝向完整、连续证据链构建方向自进化的空间推理框架。执行智能体使用角色特定记忆为每个问题获取、关联和判断证据；控制智能体从执行轨迹中诊断证据链的断裂，并联合修订工具、接口、技能、记忆组织和决策规则。这一循环使能力和证据使用共同进化：证据需求指导能力发展，可用结果指导行动。在多个基准测试中，Space-X在四个基础模型上均带来了提升。
tldr: Space-X是一个自进化的空间推理框架，通过执行智能体与控制智能体的协同进化循环，将视觉、几何和语言线索编织成完整的证据链，在四个基础模型和多个基准测试上均取得了提升。
en_tdlr: Space-X is a self-evolving spatial reasoning framework that weaves visual, geometric, and linguistic clues into complete evidence chains through a co-evolving loop between an Execution Agent and a Control Agent, yielding gains across multiple benchmarks with four base models.
